data.summary: All figures match Apple's reported FY2022/FY2021 results: revenue $394.3B vs $365.8B (+7.8%), gross profit $170.8B vs $152.8B (43.3% margin), operating income $119.4B vs $108.9B (30.3% margin), net income $99.8B vs $94.7B (+5.4%), diluted EPS $6.11 vs $5.61, R&D $26.3B vs $21.9B. Calculations and characterizations are correct.
